text:
Maya: Quick question — where's the dashboard that breaks down SM% / GPU memory / KV-cache hit by model + instance type for dedicated clusters? Need it for a PR embed.
Kevin: Use the 'gpu-throughput' dashboard in Grafana, I usually filter with var-cluster=dedicated-prod. link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/gpu-throughput
Maya: thanks — do you have panel IDs? I want to embed single panels in docs.
Ana: panel ids I use: SM% -> 211, Memory% -> 212, KV hit -> 259, Batch-size distribution -> 307
Maya: perfect. any panel that shows p99 decode latency by model variant?
Kevin: panel 318 shows p50/p95/p99 by model. also traces link in span: https://traces.redwood.internal/trace/abcde
Maya: also, what's our alert suggestion for gpu memory? currently prod noisy at 88% for short spikes.
Luis: I bumped staging alert to trigger at 92% sustained 3m. For prod we agreed 95% sustained 2m or OOM pattern. :+1:
metrics-bot: Incident detected: gpu-mem-high firing on dedicated-prod/gpu-12 with value 93.4% — runbook: /runbooks/gpu-mem
Maya: can someone share the alert YAML so I can reference it in the PR?
Ana: paste below
```
alert: GPUHighMemory
expr: avg_over_time(gpu_memory_utilization[2m]) > 0.95
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "GPU memory >95% on {{ $labels.instance }}"
  runbook: "https://wiki.redwood/internal/runbooks/gpu-memory"
```
Maya: awesome. last quick q — is there a panel that correlates batch size vs. SM% so I can show impact of increasing batch to 64?
Kevin: panel 307 (batch-size distribution) + SM% panel have a transform, or use the query tab to join by job. I can drop a permalink in a bit.
deploy-bot: deploy noticed rolling canary for model-enc-v2 on dedicated-prod — may cause temporary sm% spikes
Maya: thanks team — I'll embed the panels and the alert snippet in the PR and tag eng-sre for review.
Kevin: ping me if you need the panel json, I can export.
Luis: noted, will monitor the alert sources during the PR testing window.
